# llms.txt

> llms.txt for the HAX ecosystem — agent discovery and skill installation.

## HAX Ecosystem

The HAX (Headless Authoring eXperience) ecosystem is a comprehensive web development platform for rapid creation of accessible, performant web components and static sites. It consists of a monorepo with 250+ LitElement components, a HAXcms content management system, a DDD design system, and extensive tooling.

## Interface Skills (canonical source: `create`)

The following interface skills are owned by the `create` repo (`@haxtheweb/create`, the `hax` CLI) and are version-locked to the CLI. They are NOT bundled in PRAW — install them from `create`:

- **hax-webcomponent-dev**: Web component development with LitElement, DDD, and HAXSchema
  - Canonical source: `create/src/skills/hax-webcomponent-dev/` -> shipped via `dist/skills/`
- **hax-site-building**: HAXcms site creation and theme management
  - Canonical source: `create/src/skills/hax-site-building/` -> shipped via `dist/skills/`
- **hax-ecosystem-onboarding**: New developer onboarding and environment setup
  - Canonical source: `create/src/skills/hax-ecosystem-onboarding/` -> shipped via `dist/skills/`
- **hax-claudehax**: Operate HAX sites via the HAX CLI and HAX web components
  - Canonical source: `create/src/skills/hax-claudehax/` -> shipped via `dist/skills/`
- **hax-webcomponent-documentation-writer**: Generate/maintain HAX element READMEs from custom-elements.json + haxProperties
  - Canonical source: `create/src/skills/hax-webcomponent-documentation-writer/` -> shipped via `dist/skills/`

Install all interface skills with:

```bash
hax skills install --all
```

## Workflow & Knowledge Skills (owned by PRAW)

All skills below live in `skills/` in this repo. The machine-readable discovery index (names, descriptions, digests — agentskills.io discovery spec v0.2.0) is `.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`.

- **audio-program-transcribe**: Transcribe and distill an owned audio/video program into a portable markdown staging tree
  - Path: `/skills/audio-program-transcribe/SKILL.md`
- **audio-program-hax**: Publish a transcribed audio/video program as a searchable HAXcms library site with inline playback
  - Path: `/skills/audio-program-hax/SKILL.md`
- **hax-a11y-audit**: Read-only WCAG 2.0 AA audit of authored HAX pages with HAX remediation
  - Path: `/skills/hax-a11y-audit/SKILL.md`
- **hax-content-authoring**: Author HAX page content using HAX-capable web components, DDD attributes, and pages/ conventions
  - Path: `/skills/hax-content-authoring/SKILL.md`
- **hax-content-chunking-audit**: Audit a HAX page for cognitive load / chunking and recommend HAX remediation
  - Path: `/skills/hax-content-chunking-audit/SKILL.md`
- **hax-design-system**: DDD design system application and SimpleColors migration
  - Path: `/skills/hax-design-system/SKILL.md`
- **hax-i18n-translate**: Scaffold and translate HAX web component i18n locale files at scale
  - Path: `/skills/hax-i18n-translate/SKILL.md`
- **hax-issue-analysis**: GitHub issue fetching and analysis across the ecosystem
  - Path: `/skills/hax-issue-analysis/SKILL.md`
- **hax-issue-research**: Research a HAX GitHub issue, draft a plan, and capture it as a "Plan Created" comment
  - Path: `/skills/hax-issue-research/SKILL.md`
- **hax-managed-files**: Know which HAXcms files are generated vs authored, and the protective rules around builds
  - Path: `/skills/hax-managed-files/SKILL.md`
- **hax-openstax2hax**: Convert OpenStax books into HAX sites via the openstax2hax plugin
  - Path: `/skills/hax-openstax2hax/SKILL.md`
- **hax-pattern-library-audit**: READ-ONLY diagnostic — analyze a single HAX web component against the DDD Atomic Design pattern library (composition conformance, internal contracts, library-ingest candidates)
  - Path: `/skills/hax-pattern-library-audit/SKILL.md`
- **hax-rule-management**: PRAW rule management and validation
  - Path: `/skills/hax-rule-management/SKILL.md`
- **hax-site-structure**: Read and navigate an existing HAXcms site from its portable files (site.json, pages/, files/, theme)
  - Path: `/skills/hax-site-structure/SKILL.md`
- **hax-tutorial-site**: Create a published HAXcms tutorial site from a YouTube video and a DOCX transcript, plus LinkedIn / X posts
  - Path: `/skills/hax-tutorial-site/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-backward-design**: Design HAX course units via UbD backward design; emits unit plan + HAX site skeleton
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-backward-design/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-essential-questions**: Author UbD essential and entry questions from the six-facet starter bank
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-essential-questions/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-grasps**: Frame UbD GRASPS performance tasks and pick authentic-context HAX media
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-grasps/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-six-facets**: Apply UbD six facets to write understandings and build facet-mapped rubric criteria
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-six-facets/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-stage1**: UbD Stage 1 — unpack standards into big ideas, understandings, EQs, K/S, misconceptions
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-stage1/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-stage2**: UbD Stage 2 — build evidence scrapbook, GRASPS task, facet rubric, validity self-test
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-stage2/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-stage3**: UbD Stage 3 — plan learning experiences via WHERETO from Stages 1+2
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-stage3/SKILL.md`
- **hax-ubd-unit-audit**: Read-only UbD review of an existing HAX unit with remediation handoff
  - Path: `/skills/hax-ubd-unit-audit/SKILL.md`
- **hax-udl-audit**: Read-only UDL 3.0 audit (Engagement, Representation, Action & Expression) of a HAX page
  - Path: `/skills/hax-udl-audit/SKILL.md`
- **haxcms-lrs-rater**: Run BookLooky's Looky Rating System (LRS) content rating and minimum-age recommendation on a HAXcms site's aggregated content
  - Path: `/skills/haxcms-lrs-rater/SKILL.md`
- **heosat**: Run the HEOSAT (Higher Education Open Source Assessment Tool) maturity assessment on an open source project into an evidence-backed scorecard
  - Path: `/skills/heosat/SKILL.md`
- **heosat-report-site**: Publish a HEOSAT assessment as a single-page HAXcms report site on surge, with scorecard, evidence, and social copy
  - Path: `/skills/heosat-report-site/SKILL.md`
- **oerschema-audit**: Read-only OER Schema diagnostic of authored content (HAX pages, VitePress, JSON-LD, Docs export)
  - Path: `/skills/oerschema-audit/SKILL.md`
- **oerschema-integration-finder**: Read-only scan of webcomponents/themes/backends/plugins for missing OER Schema emission/consumption
  - Path: `/skills/oerschema-integration-finder/SKILL.md`

Repo-local project skills (not in the published `skills/` set): **grad-blooms**, **hax-theme-builder**, **youtube-vtt** — under `.agents/skills/`.

## Claude Code Plugin Marketplace

PRAW hosts a Claude Code plugin marketplace with three plugins:

```text
/plugin marketplace add haxtheweb/praw
/plugin install hax-onboarding@haxtheweb
```

- **hax-onboarding** — Golden-path onboarding: auto-installs the HAX CLI, ships a knowledge skill, and provides slash commands (quickstart, site, webcomponent, audit, serve, publish).
- **hax-site-ops** — Operate HAX sites from Claude Code: add pages, create courses, update content, inspect, validate, and publish. (Renamed from the old `hax` plugin in claudehax.)
- **openstax2hax** — Prepare OpenStax books for conversion into HAX sites.

## Install Workflow Skills

```bash
npx skills add haxtheweb/praw --all

# Or install individually
npx skills add haxtheweb/praw --skill hax-design-system
npx skills add haxtheweb/praw --skill hax-openstax2hax
```

## Companion Skills (install separately)

The Anthropic document skills (`docx`, `pdf`, `pptx`, `xlsx`) are source-available, not open source, and are NOT bundled in this repo. Install them from Anthropic's official repo on your machine:

```bash
npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill docx --skill pdf --skill pptx --skill xlsx -g -y
```
